question: Why did the great fish equal in strength to the speaker fail to be caught?
premises: That great fish did not come.
The fish was equal in strength to the speaker.
inference: The great fish, equal in strength to the speaker, did not come into the net.
uncertainties: The connection to the net in verse 498 is implied but not restated.
plain_english: O beloved, that great fish, equal to me in strength, did not come.
